geometricClearance.scope: Actual v4 GLB reimport. Seven required axis checks, explicit complete-component selections and exact bounds; five coherent assemblies tested with BVH/triangle-SAT against every exported mesh including v4 extras. Only triangles explicitly selected within the same assembly are excluded as intentional intra-assembly contacts.
